evidence.autonomy_level: Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to define data requirements, access patterns, and governance standards
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Responsibilities focus on building and delivering defined infrastructure and governance standards in collaboration with stakeholders, rather than independently setting overall strategy, placing this at execution level.

evidence.testing_framing: Ensure the production-readiness of all data solutions by implementing CI/CD practices, automated testing, and system observability
